The '''Large Cottage Rug''' is a piece of furniture. It can be purchased from [[Oasis]] for {{Price|2000}} every Monday or from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

Players who select a [[Farm Maps|Meadowlands Farm]] during character creation will have one in their house when the game begins.
